title: Binding the first JDBC batch row once when returning generated keys
summary: The merge eliminated redundant first-row bindings, and two actual generated keys identified the two inserted H2 rows.

change.description: Two generated-key paths now reuse the first row already bound during statement creation. The change reaches named batches through NamedParameterJdbcTemplate and indexed batches through JdbcClient.

notes: The recording wrapper forwards calls to H2 2.4.240. Bind order, addBatch snapshots, update counts, generated keys and independent reads come from the same run.
